The film is a sequel to Walt Disney's 1967 film "The Jungle Book", and stars Haley Joel Osment as the voice of Mowgli and John Goodman as the voice of Baloo.»

The series ran for 28 episodes on CBS as part of "The Tarzan/Lone Ranger Adventure Hour".  Tonto was voiced by Ivan Naranjo, a Blackfoot/Southern Ute actor who hailed from Colorado.»
